When Darcy's birthday party falls on the same day as one of Lisa's hero scientist's talks, Lisa sends TODD in her place to the party. // Flip sees a lucrative business opportunity when he discovers Nacho has the ability to predict the weather.

Max and Phoebe attend Parent-Teacher Night, leaving Chloe and friends home without adult supervision. When Jinx finds the Air Lair, he believes spies are targeting the school, and his meddling puts the Thundermans' school jobs at risk.

Chloe feels smothered by Max and Phoebe, and encourages them to make new friends. However, the twins unwittingly make the same friend, and begin a battle for the ages over her. Chloe's new alone time is interrupted by living room-crashing pelican.
After Schwoz's experiment-gone-wrong causes an infestation at Sw.A.G, Danger Force enrolls at Swellview Junior High and stumbles into an extra-curricular crime wave.
Danger Force is crushing it at Swellview Junior High, but Ray misses his sidekicks and schemes to get them out of school.
Kid Danger and Captain Man are called to the Swellview Museum of Stools and Jewels to protect the rare Neal Diamond from being stolen.
After a prank gone wrong, Sadie and Lay Lay must trick Principal Willingham into believing Sadie is Lay Lay's grandmother for a parent-teacher conference.

Hope makes lots of noise whilst skateboarding, and her howls are heard around the city causing lots of drama. // The Twins manage the Smoothie Bar and the Marsups end up creating the best smoothie ever.
Thinking she hasn't been invited to Bibi's party Jade sneaks in. // Mica doesn't finish his robot in time for the school science fair, so the Marsupilamis squeeze inside and operate it.

When Leni is put in charge of the school's prom, she is determined to make it the most memorable night ever. // Lincoln and Clyde cast Luan as the villain, Bee Trayal, in their David Steele film and have to deal with her method acting.

Tensions run high when Lincoln and Clyde both get an internship at Flip's and compete to win the manager title. // When Lincoln sees how tame Pop Pop has gotten in his older age, he takes him out for a day to remember.

Jung-hwan, a professional wild animal trainer, spends his days bickering and playing with his teenage daughter, Soo-ah, who is passionate about dancing. Then one day, Soo-ah gets infected by a zombie virus that sweeps across the world. To protect her, Jung-hwan takes Soo-ah to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Bam-soon, lives. In a society determined to root out the infected, Jung-hwan notices that Soo-ah still seems to understand words, responds to her favorite songs and dances, and even flinches when scolded by Grandma Bam-soon's back scratching stick. Refusing to give up on his daughter, Jung-hwan calls on his years of animal training experience and begins the top-secret mission of training his zombie daughter...
A TV news unit live broadcasts the embarrassing defeat of a police battalion by five bank robbers. Later, Inspector Rebecca decides to turn the stakeout into a breaking news show.

When undercover agent Ding receives an encrypted message from Blackjack, who claims to be an undercover agent that has lost contact with the police, she reports it to her superior officer Inspector Q, who immediately launches a mission to search for Blackjack. During the mission, Ding visits a casino where she discovers that the supposedly dead triad leader Foon-hei is surprisingly alive and kicking. Meanwhile, Inspector Q narrows down Blackjack's whereabouts when he learns of a finance group's involvement in a drug deal in Brazil. The deal involves company chairman Kwok Ming, his advisor Lam, Lam's right-hand man Shiu and Foon-hei, who is plotting a comeback to the crime world. When the players learn of an undercover agent in their midst, paranoia and distrust begin to cloud over the deal...
Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

If karma does not exist, would you still choose kindness? Based on true events, In Broad Daylight reveals a little-known truth about residential care homes for the disabled that hides beneath the headlines. A news organization's investigative journalism unit receives a tip about the abuse of residents in Rainbow Bridge Care Home. To expose the home's wrongdoings, reporter Kay goes undercover to expose the inhumanity inside, searching for the cruel truth under broad daylight.

“I was perfect until God threw this woman into my life” JUNG-YEOL, the intelligent and handsome loser. “He's like a mosquito. Who knows why they exist?” NARA, the successful careerwoman born with a side of crazy. Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again. But......with D-30 until they stamp their papers, a fateful accident inflicts amnesia on the star-crossed couple.
It is an exploration of one woman's wacky life of prostitution, spanning over 20 years in Hong Kong. Unattractive but happy-go-lucky and spunky, KUM is a true Hong Kong survivor.

A horrifying story of a shaman's inheritance in the Isan region of Thailand. What could be possessing a family member might not be the Goddess they make it out to be. A documentary team follows Nim, a shaman based in Northern Thai, the Isan area, and encounters her niece Mink showing strange symptoms that seem to be of inheritance of shamanism. The team decides to follow Mink, hoping to capture the shaman lineage passing on to the next generation, but her bizarre behavior becomes more extreme.

In this interview, Jo Koo shares about her journey in the entertainment industry. She advocates creating characters based on current feelings and imagination, because she believes the essence of acting lies in 'believing' that only by seeing the world directly, like the children in the film “Distinction,” can one perfectly merge with the character. Looking back on her career's ups and downs over the years, she jokes that she and her fellow actors were like 'different species,' and she never deliberately planned her life. Precisely this easygoing attitude has shaped the unique Jo Koo we know today.

Tamio Akanishi is a hapless public servant who has just hit the low point of his life having been dumped by his fiancee. He spends his days living alone in a big house he had bought for a married life that never materialized. At the recommendation of his concerned boss, he adopts a large white dog that had been abandoned by a previous owner who had mistreated him. The dog can only eke out a raspy whisper due to having had his vocal cords removed. Tamio names the extremely loving and trusting dog 'Haw' for the sound he makes, and thus begins the rapturously joyful life of a man and his dog.

The Yau's brothers are a trio of scammers who make punishing baddies their mission. A misunderstanding leads them to fellow con artists the Lui's sisters, and they join hands to scam a notorious mob boss. Through a myriad of ingenious tricks and disguises, they bring the mobster to justice as romance blossoms swiftly...

The great adventure stories of worn goods that build bridges between people from all walks of life, following a former baseball player, a sleepless student, a new hangman, an imprisoned gangster, and a mysterious father and daughter. Kwang-sung was once a rising baseball star but he is now a desperate man, cold, hungry, hunted by two hitmen. One day he receives a call from a little boy Jae-ha who asks him to sell his baseball jacket. Na-na is Jae-ha's English teacher who is trying to investigate a murder case that Kwang-sung must be involved. Ye-ji helps Kwang-sung's escape when she sells Min-hyuk a sleep-time controller. Her brother Soo-jung is a hangman who actually wants to be a rock star. Jae-ha's uncle Seok-ho visits a story hunter and his mysterious daughter to sell off his old bittersweet memories. When they are about to shake hands, Anna Karenina suddenly comes in. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exciting c

Emperor Zhengde of the Ming Dynasty is young and playful, privately escapes from Palace to avoid the appointed marriage. He loses his memory by accident and luckily comes across Ms. Li to take care him. Prince Ningxia takes this opportunity to rebel the kingdom and catch the emperor to execute him immediately at the execution ground. At a critical time, three entourages rescue the Emperor and the prince Ningxia is arrested. However, Ms Li has refused to get marriage with the emperor due to his cheating on her love feelings.

p.t: Crayon Shinchan the Movie: Super-Hot! The Spicy Kasukabe Dancers
p.d: To commemorate the sister city relationship between Kasukabe and Mushibai Hagashimiru in India, the 'Kasukabe Children's Carnival' was held. Word spread that winning the carnival's dance competition would earn a trip to India. Shin-chan, alongside with his trusty Kasukabe friends lit up the stage with a spectacular performance, clinching the championship and setting off for the curry-scented and starlit wonders of India! But little did they know, a thrilling adventure had beguan. During their India journey, Shin-chan and Bo-chan wandered into a shady general store and bought a peculiar nose-shaped backpack, unaware of its dark secret. Disaster struck when Bo-chan accidentally stuffed a mysterious slip of paper from the backpack in his nose, unleashing an evil force that transformed him into “Tyrant” Bo-chan, a rampaging villain with the power to destroy the world! With Bo-chan's personality warped and his actions spiralling out of control, can Shin-chan and his friends harnes

Cheung Ka-shing and Man have been friends for many years and both of them are the owner of a garage. Cheung has invented a chip to win the sports car competition and gave the right to use the chip to Wen after the race. Cheung met a lovely girl, Kitty and fell in love with her at first sight. A landslide occurred the day before Kitty moved out of her house, Kitty and Cheung were trapped in the car. The president of a large Japanese Corporation came to Hong Kong to find Cheung. After the group study the function of the chip, they believed that the chip has a very big potential market value. Cheung is hailed as the next-generation empire of the automotive industry. Cheung and Man have started to invest in real estate, stock market and other businesses. Cheung meets Kitty again at a banquet but found that she has married. Cheung accidentally meets a supernatural master who can help Cheung dreaming with Kitty, therefore Cheung has become fascinated the dreaming with Kitty and pai

Lung was an informer of Police in the triad society. But his identity was exposed and lost all memory after hurt. All of money that given by the Police was lost. The Police suspicious Lung had hidden the money. So he was wanted by the triad society and Police. Sing was a little thief, he knew Lung and made friend together. He knew everything about Lung then, and he wanted to help Lung to recover his memory aimed to take back the money. Fong was a manger in a big firm. He had stolen a large amount of money of his firm and was discovered by his colleague later. So he wanted to kill Wu but failed. Fong also wanted the money of Lung, as a result, he wanted to kill Lung also. Wu was saved by Lung and Sing. The Boss of Fong knew everything were exposed and ordered Koo to kill Lung, Sing and Wu. But Wu won't do that because of their friendship...

During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses...

p.t: Once Upon A Time In China II
p.d: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

p.t: Once Upon A Time In China III
p.d: Chit the Kick breaks his leg in the fight with Wong Fey Hong, and is discarded by godfather Chao. Wong nurses him and teams up with him in a martial arts tournament to defeat Chao...
12 particular nights, from falling in love to drifting apart to a tentative separation and, to the inevitable split, these nocturnal passages encapsulate the entire experience.

Alias “Springing Gazelle”, the renowned athlete Miss Chi Cheng is in Hong Kong helping to organize a training programme and hunt for a coach. Olivia was a former brilliant sprinter who has to give up running after her injury in a competition. At the beginning of the training, the girls are too pompous that they despise Olivia, until they find that Olivia is beyond their challenge, they adore her and are willing to go through the hardship but after a winning contest, they feel hostility towards each other and behave proudly. As a result, they lost in the competition with Singapore team. Olivia is so furious...

Abel graduated from a renowned school of fashion design in Japan. He came back to Hong Kong and joined a top fashion company. In an office party, he met Jeanne and Rookie, radio DJ who is a friend of his boss, Derek. Abel and Jeanne had a bit of misunderstanding at first and became enemies. Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends...

Swords, like diamonds, sometimes carry a curse. And the famous sword Chi Mud is such a sword. When swordmaster Wah acquires Chi Mud, he is advised to destroy it or he will be killed by this very sword. Wah does not listen. He has already retired into seclusion and does not think the young swordsmen can find and challenge him. Li is such a young swordsman. He even has dueled and killed another young challenger. Li by accident saves a young girl from a professional killer. In a few days, the girl and Li become friends. But the girl leaves in anger when Li meets his old flame Hsiao Yue, now married to Lin Wan. Li is ambushed by killer Chan...

Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

A story about two different men each finding their true meanings in life. LESLIE and TONY, two lower middle-class bachelors, are bosom friends. Leslie is a wandering soul who seems unable to settle down. He got fired and his girlfriend left him. Tony is a frustrating musician and a part-time worker at an elderly home. He doesn't like old people, but works there only to get close to his dream girl WAI...
Celia sneaks into Hong Kong to save her brother. Unfortunately, she gets involved in a triad murder and meets Frank at this time and a loving relationship develops...

One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina...
Young architect Rick treats love as a game. One day, while he was checking out the poster of writer Lok Ching-I's new book, he got hit by a car...

p.t: Zu: Warriors From The Magic Mountain
p.d: An army deserter Di Ming Qi, who was chased by vampires in the mountain of Zu. He was rescued by Master Ding Yin and became his pupil. When they were ambushed by the Blood Devil, devil chaser Xiao Ru and his pupil Yi Zhen came to their assistance. With the help of Master Chang Mei, they managed to hold off the Blood Devil but they need to find the Dual Swords to destroy it. Master Ding took the wounded Xiao Ru to Celestial Fort and sought help from the Mistress, but was in turned poisoned by the Blood Devil and he surrendered to the Dark Force. Will Di and Yi Chen find the Dual Swords and destroy the Blood Devil?

《山河之影》改編自路陽執導的同名系列電影《繡春刀》，講述兩位少年以赤子情懷協力衝破人生困境的江湖故事。 建文三年，雞鵝巷的小賊李霧濟南府金事王克恭攜萬貫家財平調進入南京城，便盜錦衣百戶李東方之名帖潛入王克恭府夢想著順利盜寶，在一夜之間坐擁菜華富貴。不料王克恭府中暗流湧動，李霧被迫捲入了一場圍繞魚瞑鎖展開的前朝火器之爭中，原本作為局外人的李霧成為了魚瞑鎖的持有者，陷入了漩渦中心。兒時，將李霧詔獄中解救的孩童宋真如今已成為錦衣衛陸錚，與李霧成了同僚，相見不相認；和李霧曾同處個囚室的女童舒棠變成了夜不收刺客，並跟李霧成了間諜夫妻，共同完成夜不收的任務。朝野紛爭的陰暗與殘酷讓三人之間的感情也在連環鎖樣的陰暗中經受著考驗。當改朝換代的那一刻到來的時候，所有的戰事和未解的迷局，都將落下帷幕。

從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

以「尋找勢均力敵的參與者」為核心模式，通過團隊協作任務獲取生存物資，個人競技爭奪約會權，並設置淘汰機制與心動投票綁定規則；素人嘉賓們將逃離都市，直面愛情與生存的挑戰，在人群中尋找勢均力敵的彼此。
全新研發的大型互動健康科普節目；從「重治療」到「重預防」，加大醫療健康知識的深度普及，把權威的資訊送到身邊。
節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴。

邀請文博愛好者組成「文物代言人」，通過多元形式演繹國寶故事；以舞台創演、文創開發的創新形式，搭建起傳統文化與年輕群體的溝通橋樑，為文化傳承注入青春活力與澎湃動能。
由張純燁、伊能靜、張繼科、朱正廷、宋雨琦、姜振宇等人組成的「戀愛觀察團」，8位年輕男女於雲南大理「浪漫滿屋」合宿一個月，開啟同一屋簷下的合租模式，並於其中彼此之間出現的信號進行推理愛情。

22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛？
全明星沉浸式劇情體驗綜藝；圍繞遊戲、喜劇兩大元素，以社會熱點話題為創作基礎，打造不同遊戲主題。一個盒子空間，一群神秘玩家，他們需要在各種離奇、爆笑和反轉中，一步步揭開故事真相，走出盒子，體驗一場專屬的心靈療愈之旅。
腦洞鑑定類綜藝推理脫口秀，陣容為薛之謙、大張偉、楊迪、劉維、黃子弘凡、黃聖依、龐博等…節目圍繞著當下熱梗熱點、觀眾的興趣點、共鳴點展開故事；火星特工廣發英雄帖正面對撞，迎戰近年最出圈、最有趣、最敢說的廠牌大咖們，真金不怕火煉，一場席卷全網的廠牌巔峰之戰即將展開！
大型腦力競技真人秀，以「以省之名，我們一起贏」為slogan，由蔣昌建擔任主持人，攸佳寧、龐博、魏坤琳組成中國戰隊領隊候選人，並由朱丹及黃聖依等組成最強啦啦隊，以創新為魂，團隊為翼，共赴腦力盛宴。
將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

Possessing a unique combination of high reproductive capacity, size, and adaptability, the feral hog absolutely decimates entire ecosystems. With pork chops on his mind, Yia travels to the Florida/Alabama border to join Jennifer Bearden and Zack Franks who are doing their part to help control the rampant feral hog population menacing Florida.

Despite the icy waters and cold conditions, the competition between the divers is fierce although for one member of the team it will be their last trip.

Deion Sanders takes his first camping trip in the wild - World-renowned survivalist Bear Grylls takes NFL Hall of Famer Deion Sanders to the mesas and canyons of Utah for his first-ever camping trip. Even though Sanders is a fish out of water, he takes a huge leap of faith and accepts Bear's challenges.

World-renowned survivalist Bear Grylls takes Tom Arnold (Sons of Anarchy (2008)) through the unpredictable coastal mountains of Oregon, taking on steep terrain, river crossings and oceanside cliffs. Arnold attempts to channel the courage and determination from his weight-loss struggle in order to tackle a journey that takes him to the brink of mental and physical exhaustion.

In China, Rooftop and Catfish continue their East Asian adventures. As if the leeches in Indonesia weren’t enough, the bikers move on to bee sting therapy in China, strengthen their stomachs with some grasshoppers and mice wine, and attempt to transport hundreds of pounds of fish on nothing but a bike and sheer will power. The duo also undergo a hike of Chinese mountain Hua Shan, electro acupuncture, and kung fu train, all to be able to endure dim mak, ‘the death touch.’ Can Rooftop and Catfish handle this intense physical journey, or will the death touch get the best of them?

Off to Vietnam next, Rooftop and Catfish embark on what may be their most dangerous visit yet. The BMX bikers start their journey relatively tame with a shot of snake blood. However, things quickly escalate from there with the most intense game of frogger they’ve ever played in the Vietnamese streets. From a hospital visit and racing through the Vietcong tunnels to trying fertilized baby bird eggs and relaxing in a boiling hot spring, nothing can prepare the duo for the ending of their trip heading to the demilitarized zone to detonate bombs. After this trip to Vietnam, what more heart-racing adventures and Rooftop and Catfish possibly find?

The white sand beaches and emerald green waters of Destin, Florida are the setting for the 'World's Luckiest Fishing Villages.' Beneath the water's surface, it's a different story...one of the most formidable species, the lionfish, has been wreaking havoc on the local ecosystem for decades. The ecological advantage of the lionfish is its venomous spikes, used to corner prey and protect itself from predators, and giving it an advantage over native fish. Luckily, local conservationists and fishing captains discovered years ago that lionfish are as tasty as they are dangerous. Yia joins local biologist Alex Fogg as he works to mitigate the lionfish's damage by harvesting them one buttery, flaky bite at a time.

The series aims to showcase the significant transformations taking place in various aspects such as politics, economy, technology, and culture.

The program consists of three segments: 'Viewing the World with Shih', 'Discussing the Past and Present' and 'Speaking New Words'. The senior commentator Shih Chi Ping analyzes the world's political and economic topics from a unique point of view, and deeply analyzes the global trends to audience.

Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that he’s not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, “When I was your age...” Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didn't go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, “When I was your age,” gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?”
